name: campaign-reward
description: Khan won game 4 and picks the winner's reward. It started in China twice; Enclave leads the campaign on wins.

history: game 1: held on, started in China
game 2: held on, started in China

options.label: Name a continent
options.hint: You (this player) get +1 troop whenever you hold that whole continent, in every future game.

options.label: Found a major city
options.hint: Population 2 in a territory you control; only you may start there in future games.

options.label: Fortify a city
options.hint: +1 to both defence dice there for 10 uses; costs 2 extra troops to expand into.

options.label: Cancel a scar
options.hint: Remove a scar from a territory for good.

options.label: Destroy a territory card
options.hint: That territory's resource card leaves the game for good.
